22:56.text: The sovereignty on that Day will be that of Allâh
. He will judge between them. So those who believed
(in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism)
and did righteous good deeds will be in Gardens of delight

22:57.text: And those who disbelieved and belied Our Verses
, for them will be a humiliating torment

22:58.text: Those who emigrated in the Cause of Allâh and after that were killed or died, surely, Allâh will provide a good provision for them. And verily, it is Allâh Who indeed is the Best of those who make provision.

22:59.text: Truly, He will make them enter an entrance with which they shall be well-pleased, and verily, Allâh indeed is All-Knowing, Most Forbearing.

22:60.text: That is so. And whoever has retaliated with the like of that which he was made to suffer, and then has again been wronged, Allâh will surely help him. Verily Allâh indeed is Oft-Pardoning, Oft-Forgiving.

22:61.text: That is because Allâh merges the night into the day, and He merges the day into the night. And verily, Allâh is All-Hearer, All-Seer.

22:62.text: That is because Allâh - He is the Truth
(the only True God of all that exists, Who has no partners or rivals with Him)
invoke besides Him, it is Bâtil
. And verily, Allâh - He is the Most High, the Most Great.

22:63.text: See you not that Allâh sends down water
from the sky, and then the earth becomes green? Verily, Allâh is the Most Kind and Courteous, Well-Acquainted with all things.

22:64.text: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth. And verily, Allâh - He is Rich
